messages:
Maya: Heads up — March cross-region GPU bill spike. We have ~$12k in untagged charges from us-east1 that map to instances with a migration tag: `migrate-2026-mar` :thinking_face:
Tom: That was the automated nodepool migration to new machine types. We expected live-migrate but a subset were recreated, which may have lost metadata propagation to billing labels.
Iris: Yeah, the migration job re-created instances without injecting the `team` label in the instance metadata. I added a fix to the migration template to copy labels.
Maya: Finance — can we reassign these charges? They currently appear under `unlabeled` in internal dashboards and are blowing team budgets.
finance-bot: Reclassification window = 30 days. Please submit CSV with (instance_id, owner_team, amount, invoice_id). Automated reclass will run on next allocation.
Tom: I can produce the CSV by joining instance metadata with the migration run logs. Quick query: `SELECT instance_id, proto.metadata, cost FROM billing.gcp_export WHERE invoice_month='2026-03' AND proto.metadata CONTAINS 'migrate-2026-mar'`
Iris: Added a post-migration step to ensure billing labels are reattached; pushed rev `migrate-7b2a`. We'll monitor.
Maya: Also, any chance the cloud vendor will do a one-off credit since metadata loss was from their agent during live-migrate?
CFO-Bot: Vendor credits considered if systemic or > $20k. For <$20k prefer internal reclassification. Escalate if recurring across quarters.
Tom: CSV ready, attaching sheet: https://redwood-internal/sheets/migrate-backfill-2145 (read-only).
Maya: Ticket opened: FIN-2026-592 with CSV + invoice id. Please tag when processed.
finance-bot: FIN-2026-592 received. We'll queue reclass. Expect adjustments in next internal run.
Iris: Monitoring automation for 24h to ensure labels persist.
Maya: Thanks — action list: Tom -> CSV (done), Iris -> monitor fix, Finance -> apply reclass. Closing here after allocation completes. :white_check_mark:
